name: FormBee Self-Hosted Form Backend
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form backend for website submissions, with email, Telegram and webhook integrations; no vendor-enforced software usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Hosted formbee.dev has been offline since July 2026; only the self-hosted software is free. Provide your own Docker/server, database and any email or integration services; deployment templates may incur hosting charges.
